title: Ramana Dayaram Shetty v. International Airport Authority of India (IAAI)

content.caseIdentity: Ramana Dayaram Shetty v. International Airport Authority of India (IAAI), (1979) 3 SCC 489
content.holding: Formulated the Instrumentality or Agency Test: a corporation acting as an agency of the Government falls within Article 12 regardless of whether it is statutory or non-statutory.
